verdict.rationale: Notte's core offering is a built-in web agent that takes natural-language tasks: the GitHub repo says you can give agents tasks on websites, the homepage says to describe a task in one prompt and watch it happen, and an agent-start API runs agents to act on your behalf. Live view lets you watch the delegated work as it runs. One hands-on report of a failed extraction on hyatt.com raises a reliability concern but does not contradict that the capability exists. Missing for 10: evidence of an in-product conversational assistant in the console/UI (versus API/SDK-driven agents), detailed docs on agent task scoping and handoff, and positive independent hands-on corroboration of task success.
